Ruling: the conflict resolves by keeping trunk's already-landed version of that hunk; T-0199's own patch for it becomes a no-op and git drops the now-empty commit on rebase. Nothing else in the branch's diff changes — Task 6's writes (asf/record/ingest.py, tests/test_ingest.py) and both prior rounds' verdicts stand untouched, confirmed by re-running tests.test_ingest, tests.test_proves and tests.test_backlog green on the rebased tree.
